title: Student Registration Form
changes: Rejoined the string "Not Selected" split over PDF lines.
notes: Create an ASP.NET Web Application (.NET Framework), select Web Forms, and name it StudentRegForm. Use the template to generate designer and project files; copy these two files into it. ASP.NET Core templates do not support Web Forms controls.

title: Registration Form with Validation Controls
notes: The PDF supplies only ASPX markup. It references Validation.aspx.cs, class StudentRegForm.Validation, and handler btnReg_Click, but does not supply their code. Those pieces and the Web Forms designer must be supplied in a .NET Framework Web Forms project before running this example.

title: AdRotator Control
notes: Listed in the index but absent from the PDF body.

title: Different Types of Cookies
changes: Named the controller file CookieController.cs to match the class; the PDF heading says CookiesController.cs.
notes: Create an ASP.NET Core MVC project named CookieDemo, copy these files into the indicated folders, keep the template startup files, and open /Cookie/Index. The code demonstrates a persistent cookie with a seven-day expiry. A separate session-cookie example is absent despite the stated aim.

title: Product Table with EF Core (Insert Operation)
changes: Wrapped the partial connection string in a complete JSON object, closed ConnectionStrings, and rejoined MultipleActiveResultSets.
notes: Create an ASP.NET Core MVC project named WebApplication5 and copy these files, keeping template tag-helper imports. Install Entity Framework Core, SqlServer and Tools packages for the target framework, then follow the PDF migration steps. SQL Server LocalDB and database setup are required. Open /Product/Index; the source startup defaults to a Home route whose controller is not supplied in the PDF.

title: College Information Portal as PWA
changes: Saved the plain HTML as index.html to match the manifest (PDF heading: Index.cshtml); normalized CSS/JS/JSON filename casing to match the HTML.
Changed cache entry /css/site.css to /style.css, matching the supplied stylesheet.
Removed decorative characters that the PDF text layer could not decode.
notes: HTML, stylesheet, manifest and service worker are supplied. Referenced PNG icons are not supplied by the PDF. Add them at the manifest paths for a complete installable PWA.

title: PWA with Custom Offline Page
changes: Normalized offline.html casing to match the service worker.
notes: This offline-page extension expects a home page at /, /style.css and worker registration code. Those are not provided in this section. Integrate it with the college portal practical or an existing site.

title: PWA with Offline Mode using Service Worker
notes: Only the service worker is provided. The listed HTML, CSS, app.js, icons and offline page, plus registration code, must exist in a host site. Missing listed assets can make precaching fail. Integrate this worker into an existing PWA.

title: Student Record Management PWA
changes: Closed the incomplete BSc CS option tag.
Removed an undecodable heading icon and normalized the HTML filename.
notes: The PDF contains HTML and localStorage logic only. It references manifest.json and /sw.js, but neither is supplied here. Add these and manifest icons for offline page loading and installability. Records are stored in this browser.

title: HTML Page with Link to manifest.json
changes: Repaired the visibly corrupted icons array: removed duplicate text and completed the 512px entry using the same fields as the 192px entry. This completion is inferred; source.pdf preserves the original.
Removed undecodable status icons and normalized HTML/JSON filename casing.
notes: The source references style.css, /sw.js and PNG icons that are not supplied in this section. Add them to complete the PWA. A manifest alone does not make page loading work offline.

title: Simple Web API returning Student data in JSON
notes: Create an ASP.NET Core Web API project named StudentAPI with controllers enabled. Copy the model and controller into it. Startup must register controllers and map controller endpoints. Test GET /api/students and /api/students/1. The PDF does not supply Program.cs or a project file.

title: PWA Manifest and Push Notifications
changes: Moved the worker push handler into service-worker.js, as directed by the PDF comment, and removed a repeated filename heading.
notes: These are snippets. The source leaves YOUR_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY as a placeholder and omits urlBase64ToUint8Array, the /api/subscribe backend, push-sending code, HTML entry point, registration code and icons. Remote push needs this setup. The local notification function is a separate demo. No keys or credentials have been generated.

title: E-Commerce PWA with Product Listing and Offline Cart
changes: Restored the missing keyboard-icon closing quote and the opening braces for addToCart and the offline checkout branch.
Restored the service-worker feature-check closing brace and the missing initial 0 in the cart quantity reduction, which is needed for an empty cart.
Removed undecodable decorative icons; product names and prices remain intact.
notes: The PDF supplies HTML/cart code but omits manifest.json, /sw.js and PWA icons. Add them for offline page loading and installation. Checkout is only an alert demo: it does not submit orders or queue them on reconnection, despite the original alert wording. The cart uses localStorage.
